features.title: Everything you need to run the night
features.subtitle: IOMIXO Live Hub bridges you and your audience — without distracting you from the mix.

qr.title: Show the QR code at the console
qr.body: Your audience scans the QR and lands on your live page.

requests.title: Get requests without being interrupted
requests.body: No more people shouting in your ear while you mix. Requests arrive neatly in your dashboard.

control.title: You decide what to play
control.body: Approve, reject or ignore each request. The DJ always stays in control.

social.title: Promote your socials
social.body: Add Instagram, TikTok, Spotify, SoundCloud and your main links.

dates.title: Show upcoming dates
dates.body: Turn every gig into an opportunity to grow followers and bring people to your next events.

events.title: Perfect for DJs, clubs, weddings and private events
events.body: A platform built for those who live the music: from mobile DJs to venues, weddings and event agencies.

weddingShowcase.title: The interactive wedding mode
weddingShowcase.subtitle: Turn the reception into a shared experience: dedications, games and a live screen, all under the DJ's control.

dedications.title: Live romantic dedications
dedications.body: Guests send dedications to the couple from their phone. The DJ approves and projects them on the screen at the right moment.

roulette.title: Penalty roulette
roulette.body: Fun, customisable penalties drawn at random and shown on the screen to get the room involved.

shoeGame.title: The shoe game
shoeGame.body: The classic newlyweds game with custom questions: him or her? Built to warm up the party.

polls.title: Live polls 2-4 options
polls.body: Launch questions to the audience with real-time results visible to everyone.

photos.title: Guest photo album
photos.body: Guests upload photos from the night, the DJ moderates and the best ones land in the couple's album and on screen.

screen.title: Shared screen (TV / projector)
screen.body: Full-screen mode for projector or TV: dedications, photos, polls and a persistent QR for the audience to join.

branding.title: Custom branding
branding.body: Couple names, date, venue and dedicated colours: every live page becomes part of the wedding's atmosphere.

remote.title: DJ Remote Control
remote.body: Manage dedications, games and the screen from your phone while you stay in the booth.

pricing.title: Simple plans for every night
pricing.subtitle: Choose the plan that best fits the way you work.
pricing.or24hDesc: Got a one-off event? Buy temporary access without a subscription.
pricing.weddingPassDesc: Full access to every Wedding Edition feature for 24 hours from purchase. Perfect for weddings, one-off events or to try before subscribing.
